t: What Jibril said he was doing at the drowning
a: فَلَوْ رَأَيْتَنِي وَأَنَا آخُذُ مِنْ حَالِ الْبَحْرِ فَأَدُسُّهُ فِي فِيهِ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ تُدْرِكَهُ الرَّحْمَةُ
p: Fa-law raʾaytanī wa anā ākhudhu min ḥāli-l-baḥri fa-adussuhu fī fīhi makhāfata an tudrikahu-r-raḥmah
m: If only you had seen me taking the mud of the sea and stuffing it into his mouth, for fear that mercy would reach him.
